errors.text_span: “主宾词”、“因果倒词”、“省略词词”、“主谓倒词”、“省略比词”、“状语倒词”、“省略分词”和“定语后谓”、“省略类联”、“状语前句”
errors.evidence: All of the listed category names are incorrect. For example, the chart shows “主宾倒装” not “主宾词”, “因果倒装” not “因果倒词”, and “宾语前置” not “状语前句”. Some names like “省略分词” are completely hallucinated.
The description claims there are eight types of sentence patterns, but the chart clearly shows ten distinct categories.
The chart is a horizontal bar chart where the categories are arranged vertically from top to bottom, not horizontally from left to right.
The word "以" is repeated, which is a typo.

errors.text_span: 最长的柱状图表示“状语前句”，其高度为106
errors.evidence: The longest bar, with a value of 106, corresponds to the category “宾语前置” (Preposed Object), not the hallucinated category “状语前句”.
The chart does not have a legend (图例). The values are displayed as data labels next to each bar.
